base.supervision: fresh public RoBERTa-Large, original M3Net→base-fit difficulty→CMERC pipeline

scoring.policy: All 2976 get clean predictions. Before any clean scores, select 96 dialogues per score role by fixed SHA order and one fixed-rank utterance per selected dialogue. Blind AI authors+different AI reviewers. Single pass, no replacements; missing D_pred returns to clean score.
scoring.limited_coverage_reason: No locally available validated instruction paraphraser for complete cohort; this is first small audited real scoring pilot.
scoring.result_scope: Natural full held-out evaluation with predeclared limited perturbation coverage and matched-covered comparison reported separately
scoring.estimand_primary: Strong clean vs strong+D_pred, same covered train and eval rows, with exact fallback on full queue reported separately.
